footer.tagline: A smart digital platform managing the entire logistics process from driver to customer.

landing.heroLead: From application to delivery, the whole process runs on one platform — live tracking, automatic reports and role-based security.
landing.aboutLead: Fleetra brings the entire logistics chain — from driver applications to customer delivery — onto a single management and tracking platform. Admin, dispatcher, driver and customer each see exactly what they need, nothing more.
landing.aboutBullet1: Online application system for drivers with their own trucks
landing.aboutBullet2: Pick-up and drop-off points chosen with one click on the map
landing.aboutBullet3: Real-time GPS tracking with automatic ETA calculation
landing.servicesLead: From a small parcel to a full freight flow — manage it all on one platform
landing.service1Desc: Nationwide freight handled by our own network of driver-owned trucks, door-to-door.
landing.service2Desc: Warehouse capacity tracked in real time, intake and dispatch fully centralised.
landing.service3Desc: International container shipping coordinated with partner ocean carriers.
landing.service4Desc: Fast air transport for urgent shipments, fully documented end to end.
landing.service5Desc: Role-based security and full accountability tracking on every shipment.
landing.service6Desc: Cost, route and delivery statistics calculated automatically, anomalies flagged.
landing.ctaTitle: Place Your First Order, or Join Our Driver Network
landing.ctaLead: Sign-up is free and the whole process is digital — as soon as your documents are approved, the system is ready for you.
landing.testimonialsTitle: People Who Use Fleetra at Work
landing.testimonial1Quote: Planning routes and tracking driver status now takes minutes instead of hours.
landing.testimonial2Quote: I placed my order straight from the map and tracked the whole journey with one number.
landing.testimonial3Quote: I joined with my own truck, my documents were approved in a day, and I run my trip from my phone.
landing.blog1Title: The role of live tracking in digital logistics
landing.blog1Excerpt: How GPS-based tracking improves customer satisfaction, with real examples.
landing.blog2Title: 5 steps to grow your driver network
landing.blog2Excerpt: How to simplify onboarding for drivers who bring their own truck.
landing.blog3Title: Anomaly detection: keeping costs under control
landing.blog3Excerpt: Using statistical analysis to automatically flag suspicious expenses.
landing.footerDesc: From driver applications to customer delivery — Azerbaijan's digital logistics management platform.
